head_before_subject: Cross module consistency decision memory proof (#180)
note_scope: Only truth/safety corrections: token crypto, private-mode authz wiring, demo-write production guard, connector readiness labels, smoke fail-close. No business modules/schemas/governed flows rebuilt or added. No Prisma migration.

environment.dynamic_gates_detail: npx tsc/eslint/vitest cannot resolve next/@prisma/client/etc without node_modules; installing is forbidden by phase rules. Static review + node --check (for .mjs) used instead. Vitest suites added must be run in CI (node_modules present).

findings_addressed.audit_finding: H-CONN-02 — OAuth token 'encryption' was base64 behind an 'encrypted at rest' label.
findings_addressed.fix_method: Replaced base64 placeholder with authenticated AES-256-GCM. Per-workspace key derived via HKDF-SHA256 from an explicit master key (OAUTH_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY env). Fails closed (throws) when key missing/short. Versioned ciphertext 'v1gcm.<iv>.<tag>.<ct>'. decrypt refuses non-GCM (legacy base64) input. Corrected the misleading header/interface comments to describe the real scheme. Documented the required env var in .env.example (template only, no secret).
tests: src/__tests__/services/external-systems/oauth-token.service.test.ts (new 'Encryption hardening' describe): ciphertext != plaintext; ciphertext != base64(token) and starts with v1gcm.; decrypt works with correct key; decrypt fails with wrong workspace key; decrypt fails on tampered ciphertext; decrypt refuses legacy base64; fails closed when key missing; fails closed when key too short; source-contract test that no code path labels base64 as encryption (asserts createCipheriv + aes-256-gcm present, base64 line absent).

findings_addressed.audit_finding: H-PRIV-01 — private-mode-gate trusted spoofable x-private-mode-role header; real role-access service was unwired.
findings_addressed.fix_method: getPrivateModeAccess no longer reads x-private-mode-role. Role is resolved ONLY from the DB via an injected resolver (PrivateModeGateDeps.resolveRole). Added createPrismaPrivateModeResolver(prisma) wiring the real PrivateModeRoleAccessService.getUserRole (approved + non-revoked). enforcePrivateModeGate threads deps through. Fails closed when identity incomplete or no resolver wired. Identity (userId/workspaceId) still comes from the same upstream-verified x-user-id/x-workspace-id channel the rest of the middleware uses; only the authorization ROLE decision was moved to the DB. addPrivateModeContext still SETS a response header (output) — not an authz input.
tests: src/__tests__/middleware/private-mode-gate.test.ts (rewritten to prove the fix): spoofed header without resolver -> denied; spoofed header with empty DB -> denied; DB-granted role -> allowed; missing identity -> denied; requiredRole enforced from DB not header; workspace isolation (grant for ws-A does not grant ws-B); createPrismaPrivateModeResolver maps DB -> role.
findings_addressed.note_gate_callers: The gate currently has zero production route callers (grep-verified), so no live request behavior changed; the fix removes the latent spoofable path and provides the real wiring point.

findings_addressed.audit_finding: H-GROWTH-01 — pricing/retention write routes persisted only to in-memory static Maps (no DB/audit).
findings_addressed.fix_method: Option 2 (smallest safe correction): added src/lib/demo-write-guard.ts. In production the two write routes now fail closed with 503 NOT_PERSISTED_DEMO_ONLY (persistence:'in-memory', productionEnabled:false) until durable, tenant-scoped, audited persistence exists. Non-production keeps the demo path for local/dev/test. Route doc comments now state DEMO-ONLY / NON-PERSISTENT. No Prisma model added (avoided schema/migration scope).
tests: src/__tests__/lib/demo-write-guard.test.ts: blocks in production for all in-memory features; allows outside production; 503 NOT_PERSISTED_DEMO_ONLY body shape; static check that both routes import+call the guard (no unguarded production write path).

findings_addressed.audit_finding: H-SMOKE-01 — smoke scripts could pass despite unconfigured target / swallowed network errors.
findings_addressed.fix_method: scripts/smoke-tests.ts: fail closed at start if NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is unset or a placeholder (yourdomain.com/example.com) -> print BLOCKED, exit 1 (no run against a fake host). Auth-enforcement test no longer swallows non-timeout network errors: it rethrows so an unreachable protected endpoint FAILS instead of counting as 'auth enforced'. scripts/production-smoke.mjs: offline (no BASE_URL) now classified BLOCKED (was PARTIAL) while keeping the existing exit-1.
tests: node --check scripts/production-smoke.mjs => OK. smoke-tests.ts is a tsx script exercised in CI smoke jobs; change is a fail-closed guard + rethrow (no new unit harness added).

findings_addressed.audit_finding: Connectors labelled isActive:true implied live/ready though nothing connects.
findings_addressed.fix_method: Added a truthful ConnectorReadiness type and a required Provider.readiness field, set to PLACEHOLDER_ONLY for all 10 providers. Clarified that isActive means 'CSV import template available', not 'live connection'. Added isConnectorProductionReady() helper. No real connector implementation added.
tests: src/__tests__/domain/external-systems/provider-registry.test.ts (new 'Connector readiness honesty' describe): no provider is PRODUCTION_READY; every provider declares an explicit allowed readiness.

grep/read of oauth-token.service.ts, token-lifecycle.service.ts, private-mode-gate.ts, role-access.service.ts, growth routes, smoke scripts, provider-registry.ts and their existing tests
git diff --cached --stat; grep sanity checks (base64 line removed; no authz read of x-private-mode-role)

status.unit_tests: BLOCKED (no node_modules) — new/updated vitest suites must run in CI
status.db_tests: N/A (no DB touched; no Prisma schema/migration change)

remaining_risks: Dynamic gates (tsc/lint/vitest) could not run locally (node_modules absent); the added suites must go green in CI before merge.

OAuth token encryption now REQUIRES OAUTH_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY in any environment that stores external tokens; if a deploy stores tokens without it, storeOAuthToken will throw (intended fail-closed). Connectors remain PLACEHOLDER_ONLY so no live token is stored yet.

private-mode-gate has no production callers; wiring it into real private-mode routes (passing createPrismaPrivateModeResolver) is future work — the fix removes the spoofable path and provides the wiring point but does not add new gated routes.
Pricing/retention remain non-persistent (now blocked in production). Real persistence is a later phase (audit Phase 4), out of Phase 0 scope.
rollback_plan: All changes are on branch claude/phase-0-truth-safety-corrections in a single commit; revert the commit (git revert) or delete the branch. No DB migration, no data change, no CI change, so revert is clean and immediate. The only behavioral change to a running system is that the two in-memory growth write routes return 503 in production (previously accepted non-persistent writes); reverting restores the prior (unsafe) behavior.
